title: Super 8
description: A series of unexplained events follows a horrifying train derailment, leading some young filmmakers (Elle Fanning, Joel Courtney) to suspect that the catastrophe was not an accident.

title: Congo
description: Killer gorillas menace an ex-CIA agent (Laura Linney), a primatologist (Dylan Walsh) and others on a mission in Africa.

title: Hard Rain
description: A thief (Morgan Freeman), a sheriff (Randy Quaid) and the nephew (Christian Slater) of an armored-truck driver seek money bags in a flooding Indiana town.

title: The Peacemaker
description: A scientist (Nicole Kidman) and an Army Special Forces colonel (George Clooney) travel the globe in pursuit of stolen nuclear weapons.

title: Universal Soldier
description: Dead soldiers from the '60s surface in the '90s as high-tech warriors reanimated by the U.S. government.

title: The Time Machine
description: A scientist (Guy Pearce) travels into the future and meets a race of people who fear hideous monsters living under the ground.

title: Escape From Alcatraz
description: A hardened con with a history of prison breaks, is sent to serve the rest of his life sentence at Alcatraz, America's most infamously brutal and inescapable maximum security prison.

title: The Hunted
description: After its boat capsizes, a group of migrants is rescued by rich Europeans who offer shelter on the island where they are vacationing. The miracle becomes a nightmare when the saviors reveal their true plan and turn into ruthless man hunters.

title: Eagle Eye
description: Two strangers (Shia LaBeouf, Michelle Monaghan) become pawns of a mysterious woman who threatens their friends and family and uses technology to control their actions.

title: Collateral
description: A contract killer hijacks a cab and forces the driver to transport him to his assigned jobs in Los Angeles.

title: Paycheck
description: After learning that his memory has been erased, a technical wizard (Ben Affleck) goes on the run to piece together clues from his past.

title: The Island
description: In 2019 a mercenary (Djimon Hounsou) pursues two clones (Ewan McGregor, Scarlett Johansson) who escaped from a research facility after learning their true fate.

title: Witness
description: An eight-year-old Amish boy witnesses a drug-related murder in a Philadelphia train station. The Philadelphia police captain discovers that the murderers are cops trying to squelch a corruption investigation.

title: Coach Carter
description: A high-school basketball coach (Samuel L. Jackson) turns a losing team around, then faces criticism for pushing the athletes to put grades first.

title: American Beauty
description: A man (Kevin Spacey) in midlife crisis and at odds with his wife (Annette Bening) begins working out to impress his teenage daughter's (Thora Birch) friend.

title: What's Eating Gilbert Grape
description: A self-sacrificing grocery worker is pushed to the breaking point by the constant demands of his dysfunctional family.

title: Seabiscuit
description: A jockey (Tobey Maguire), an automobile magnate (Jeff Bridges) and a trainer (Chris Cooper) lead a racehorse to glory during the Great Depression.

title: The Fighter
description: Having earned a shot at a world championship, boxer Micky Ward (Mark Wahlberg) reunites with his estranged brother (Christian Bale) to train for the fight and become the new "Pride of Lowell."

title: Sands of Iwo Jima
description: A Marine sergeant (John Wayne) pushes a colonel's son (John Agar) and other recruits until they're ready to fight.

title: The General's Daughter
description: Two investigators (John Travolta, Madeleine Stowe) find an underworld of sex and cover-ups behind an Army captain's murder.

title: Enemy at the Gates
description: A Nazi sniper (Ed Harris) travels to Stalingrad to find and kill a Russian sharpshooter (Jude Law), the hero of the propaganda campaign of a political officer (Joseph Fiennes).

title: Rules of Engagement
description: A decorated career Marine (Samuel L. Jackson), about to stand trial for a botched rescue mission, asks an old friend (Tommy Lee Jones) to defend him.

title: Defiance
description: In 1941 three refugee brothers (Daniel Craig, Liev Schreiber, Jamie Bell) turn a daily struggle to survive into a personal battle to save their people from the Nazis.

title: Overlord
description: Paratroopers drop behind enemy lines to penetrate a fortified church and destroy a Nazi transmitter. Making their way to an underground lab, the soldiers stumble upon a sinister experiment that forces them into a battle against an army of the undead.
